_note: AI Battle transition timings. out_s and in_s are the fade lengths in seconds; the fade_out values are fractions of the fade-out (0 to 1); max_frame_s caps one frame's time step.

fade_out._note: the dark screen fades in over bg_in; the chip lights up from chip_at for chip_in; the traces grow from grow_at until the box opens at box_at, for box_open; the status line types in from type_at to type_end

chip._note: the chip grows from grow_from to grow_from + grow_by of its size as it lights up

via_ring._note: a via's ring scale grows from scale_from by scale_grow_by over the first grow_px of growth past the trace's end

pulses._note: signals leaving the chip while loading: one per trace, gap_px of quiet between its runs, starting lead_px before the chip
